title: SEASON ZERO M3: WORN GEAR IN LOOT BOXES
why: his rulings of 11-01 (answers 56 to 59, 62, 71, 73): gear is in loot boxes like everything else, a raid averages 4 or 5 pieces, see the traits before you take it. Numbers for the rate: his 19 real raids v35.38 to v36.66 (abandons left out) opened 259 containers, 13.6 a raid (7 extracts 20.6, 12 deaths 9.6); about 3 in 4 are map boxes (an estimate, the log does not split them), so 10.2 boxes a raid; boxes owe 3 to 4 of the 4 or 5 pieces, so 3.5 over 10.2 is 34 percent a box; 00p-m3d adds wrecks, pillagers and keycard rooms and may retune it. Rarity 60, 28, 10, 2 percent.
now: a map box may hold a worn piece, rolled once on its own dice at the first search so seed 4242 and the raid streams never move; a tip beside the search bar and in the backpack shows its name, traits and better, worse or even; it comes out as a pickup row in its rarity colour with one trait line; on an extract it joins the gear stash, on a death it is gone; looting a box with no piece is exactly what it was
